hero.title: Terms of service.
hero.body: The full terms of service are being finalised and will be published on this page. The points below summarise how plans and billing work today.

sections.title: Plans and billing in brief.
paragraphs: You can cancel any time, and your plan stays active until the end of the current billing period.
Payments are not refunded. Credits do not carry over to the next period and cannot be refunded. Extra credit packs expire at the end of the billing cycle.
After your plan ends, you can export your data for up to 30 days.

cta.title: Questions about the terms?
cta.body: Get in touch and we will answer them.
